title: capacitor-alarm: an ESP32 clock that wakes you up by exploding a capacitor, three slots,OLED display

sections.title: Transcript
paragraphs: It's an ESP32-based alarm clock that instead of beeping, sends reverse voltage through a capacitor until it pops. And that pop is your alarm. Three slots, so it's good for three mornings before you reload it. It's got an OLED clock, a web UI, current limiting resistors on each slot for safety, and it pulls the time over Wi-Fi. The creator even admits the voltage regulators double as a tiny space heater.
